subject: Post-call recap + next steps: buy-committee owners & contract routing
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@novushealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps: buy-committee owners & contract routing

Hi Michael — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track owners and the legal routing plan.

1) Who we heard on the call (confirmed owners):
- Michael Lopez — economic buyer / product sponsor
- Sarah Chen — legal counsel (contract owner)
- Tom Alvarez — procurement (PO/invoice owner)
- Raj Patel — security/compliance owner

2) Initial ask / decision criteria you shared:
- Data residency in US-only regions
- Standard breach notification SLAs (48 hours)
- Support for retention and deletion workflows for patient-adjacent data
- Competitive unit economics at 100k tokens/month baseline

3) Proposed contract sequencing (our recommendation to minimize blockers):
- Step A: NDA for mutual confidentiality (quick sign to allow deeper doc sharing) — we attached our NDA draft (Novus_NDA_draft_v1.pdf).
- Step B: Security questionnaire + demo follow-up (Raj to confirm SSO/KMS details).
- Step C: DPA (data residency + subprocessor list) — we can send a pre-populated DPA for your review.
- Step D: MSA redline pass (commercial + liability) once DPA alignment is clear.

Turn-time assumptions (please confirm):
- NDA: 2–3 business days for signature once owners confirm
- Security questionnaire: 3–7 business days depending on detail level
- DPA: 5–7 business days for initial redline from your side
- MSA: dependent on redlines — expect 5–10 business days for first pass

Immediate asks from you: 
- Confirm the owners above are correct and who will be the NDA signer.
- If Novus wants changes to the NDA, flag them inline; otherwise we’ll send a DocuSign link to Sarah/Tom for signature.
- Let us know a good time for a 30-minute sync that includes Sarah and Tom (we’d like to do that early next week).

I’ve linked our HubSpot deal and a shared Drive folder with the NDA + DPA template below. I’ll loop in Jasmine and Ben from my team to manage the contract lane and expected turn times.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-7842
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-novus-contracts

Thanks — speak soon.

—Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@novushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@novushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: buy-committee owners & contract routing

Sean — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming owners: Sarah will lead legal review and be primary NDA signer, Tom will handle procurement/PO, and Raj (copied below) owns security/compliance. I added Tom and Sarah to the thread.

Two quick items from our side:
- Data residency: we are US-only for PHI-adjacent workloads. Raj will follow up with a short list of controls we need to validate (SSO, KMS, logging).
- DPA request: can you send a version that includes explicit US-only processing and a standard subprocessor clause? If you have a short cover note that explains the key DPA points (data categories, retention, deletion), that would help speed our legal review.

We can do a joint sync next Tuesday (11/10) at 10am PT — Sarah and Tom say that works. Please send a calendar invite with the agenda and any docs you want legal to read in advance.

Also — NDA looks reasonable at first pass. If you can push it via DocuSign to Sarah that will expedite.

Thanks,
Michael
VP Product, NovusHealth
From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovusHealth — contract lane & owners (NDA/DPA/MSA sequencing)

FYI — copying an internal note so we have a clear playbook before the Tue 11/10 sync.

Key points we should own:
- Marissa: lead legal reviewer for NDA + first-pass MSA redlines (please prioritize NDA turn time of 48–72 hours).
- Ben: procurement handoff & PO/tax info; prepare standard SOW/ordering guidance for their finance team.
- I’ll own technical answers for security controls and coordinate with Raj for the questionnaire.

Recommended approach:
1) Send NDA via DocuSign to Sarah as Sean requested (Sean, if you want I can load the attachment and send).
2) Draft a DPA variant that explicitly states US-only processing + standard subprocessor obligations. I’ve started a redwood_dpa_template_v2.docx in the Drive folder and added comments about data residency.
3) Prepare a short cover memo for Sarah that highlights: retention windows, deletion process, KMS/HSM options, and audit log availability. That memo should reduce back-and-forth on the DPA.
4) For MSA redlines: propose we do the DPA pass first and only then exchange MSA commercial redlines — we want to avoid parallel redlines that increase cycle time.

Turn times I recommend we commit to for Novus: NDA 2 business days (send + e-sign), DPA initial deliverable within 48 hours after NDA, MSA first redline within 5 business days after DPA alignment. If Marissa or legal needs longer, flag immediately so we can reset expectations with Novus.

Action items:
- Sean: send DocuSign NDA to Sarah today and schedule the Tue 11/10 10am PT invite.
- Marissa: prioritize NDA review and prepare MSA checklist for common Novus asks (data residency, liability caps, breach SLA).
- Ben: pull Novus tax/PO contacts and be ready to describe our procurement workflow on the call.

I’ll start the DPA draft and drop it in the Drive.

— Jasmine
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@novushealth.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@novushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novushealth.com>, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-06T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: buy-committee owners & contract routing

Michael — thanks for confirming. I just sent the NDA via DocuSign to Sarah (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rs/novus-nda-9f3a). Novus_NDA_draft_v1.pdf is in the Drive folder for reference.

Per our internal plan: Jasmine uploaded a DPA draft (redwood_dpa_template_v2.docx) with US-only processing language and comments on subprocessor commitments. Marissa will own the legal touchpoints and will do the first MSA checklist. Ben will bring procurement/PO details to the Tue 11/10 sync.

Proposed timeline for the buyer committee:
- 11/06: NDA sent (DocuSign)
- 11/09: DPA draft delivered to Novus (Jasmine)
- 11/10: Joint sync (10am PT) with Product/Legal/Procurement/Solutions
- 11/17: Target for DPA alignment and initial MSA commercial redline

If anything changes on your side (e.g., different NDA signer, faster legal timeline), let me know and we’ll adapt. Otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite for 11/10 and include the Drive + HubSpot links.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—Sean
